{{otheruses|the [[legendary]] [[weapon]]|the [[dragon champion]]|Frostfang (dragon champion)}} {{Weapon infobox | type = axe | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot = Superior Sigil of Ice | bound = account use | skin = Frostfang (skin); Tooth of Frostfang (skin); Corrupted Skeggox; Tooth of Frostfang Experiment (skin) | id = 30684 | gallery2 = Frostfang stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | gallery3 = Frostfang footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Icy footfalls. }} [[Frostfang]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] axe crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. It is named after [[Frostfang (dragon champion)|Frostfang]], Jormag's [[Dragon champion|champion]] whom [[Asgeir Dragonrender]] slew with a single blow. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Hlif traveled to the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] to challenge [[Jormag]]. Near death, she took one last swing at her foe before falling unconscious. She awoke the next morning—her axe encased in an icy dragon's head.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Tooth of Frostfang | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Frostfang | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Frostfang]] is an icy dragon-headed axe covered in scales. While drawn, the mouth of the dragon chatters and emits a frosty breath. ;Aura * The arm wielding Frostfang is encased in a block of ice and frost, which emits a foggy vapor. ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, the sound of a cold wind can be heard and ice swirls up the arm of the hand wielding Frostfang. * When stowed, an icy aura pulses from the mouth and tiny bits of snow fall. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind icy footprints. ;Kill animations * Enemies killed by Frostfang will display chilled death animations. ;Sound effects Successful melee strikes and ranged projectiles hits will sound like crumbling ice for all skills. This effect can get loud when striking multiple times such as with [[Whirling Defense]] or [[Imaginary Axes]] with several clones using [[Mirrored Axes]] and [[Infinite Horizon]]. ;Skill effects * Default class weapon trails are replaced with icy trails. * Ranged skills will throw Frostfang instead of the default projectile. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{w}} [[Warrior]]: [[Throw Axe]], and [[Throw Rock]] (downed skill). ** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: [[Essence Sap]] (downed skill) and [[Frigid Blitz]]. ** {{r}} [[Ranger]]: [[Path of Scars]], [[Ricochet]], [[Splitblade]], [[Throw Dirt]] (downed skill), and [[Winter's Bite]]. *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: Any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as [[Narcotic Spores (soulbeast)|Narcotic Spores]]. ** {{n}} [[Necromancer]]: [[Dhuumfire (death shroud skill)|Dhuumfire]], [[Dark Path]] and [[Life Blast]]. ** {{mirage}} [[Mirage]]: Phantasmal axes thrown by [[Imaginary Axes]] and the [[Mirrored Axes]] trait. === Gallery === File:Frostfang concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]].
